title: This Free Open-Source AI Codes Like Claude Code
description:
Comment OPEN and I'll send you the link.

You can build a full app for free with this. The tool is called OpenCode. It's open-source, works right in your terminal, and gives you everything the paid ones do.

Install it with one command, then pick any model you want — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Kimi, or even a free model running on your own laptop. It has a planning mode where the AI maps the task first, and a build mode where it writes the actual code. All the usual features are there: skills, MCP, sub-agents, edits shown right in the code.

Over 150,000 developers already starred it on GitHub, and it's used by more than 6 million developers every month.

#ai #aitools #opensource #coding #devtools
